response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, (CAST(SUM(derived_product_cost) AS REAL) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS overall_avg FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.avg_quantity, inv.cost_ratio, inv.avg_quantity - overall.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM inv CROSS JOIN overall WHERE inv.avg_quantity > overall.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text but numeric, so it is cast to a number before averaging.
The overall average is the mean of the per-invoice average quantities, with each invoice weighted equally. It is not the mean over all line items.
If an invoice's total derived_total_cost is 0, its cost ratio is NULL instead of raising a division error.
